description: Create a new Auto Scaling Group (VPC). Requires a launch configuration, one subnet (subnetNo) and 1-3 ACGs. vpcNo is looked up from the subnet when omitted. For load-balancer health checks set healthCheckTypeCode=LOADB with healthCheckGracePeriod and targetGroupNoList. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

accessControlGroupNoList.description: ACG numbers applied to servers created by scale-out (1-3)

autoScalingGroupName.description: Auto Scaling Group name (1-255 chars: lowercase letters, digits, '-'; start with a letter, end with a letter or digit; auto-generated when omitted)

desiredCapacity.description: Desired number of servers (between minSize and maxSize; defaults to minSize)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating

healthCheckGracePeriod.description: Health check grace period in seconds (default 300). Required when healthCheckTypeCode=LOADB.

healthCheckTypeCode.description: Health check type: SVR (server, default) or LOADB (load balancer — requires healthCheckGracePeriod)

launchConfigurationNo.description: Launch configuration number to use (from ncloud_list_launch_configs)

minSize.description: Minimum number of servers (0-30, ≤ maxSize; 0 keeps no servers)

serverNamePrefix.description: Server name prefix (3-7 chars: lowercase letters, digits, '-'). Servers are named {prefix}-{random}.

subnetNo.description: Subnet number for the servers (a single subnet — the API takes one value)

targetGroupNoList.description: Target group numbers to attach. Only valid with healthCheckTypeCode=LOADB.

vpcNo.description: VPC number. Optional: when omitted, the tool reads it from subnetNo (ncloud_get_subnet_detail).

name: ncloud_create_asg
